question: After the 12-case suite left Sol saturated, do five-appointment plans create reliable contrast, and does early abandonment help at the same call budget?
unit: One codex exec invocation for one environment action; provider-internal retries or hidden requests are not separately observed.
adaptive_rule: After every completed rollout use only this group's observed exact binary rewards. At n>=2, abandon unanimous groups when (4-n)/5 < .45. Mixed groups continue to a fixed size of four. Never use unseen rewards or oracle cost in selection.
uniform_rule: Complete groups of four in a prespecified balanced cyclic task order. No outcome-dependent prompt selection.
task_order: Two stress cases, seed-shuffled each cycle with random.Random(27900+cycle); same stream in all four arms.
pilot: The original 12 pilot trajectories used 64 CLI invocations and are excluded from v2 comparisons. No new pilot. Task IDs, business rules, group size, prior, thresholds, and ordering remain those frozen for v1.
pilot_adapter_change: Before comparison, disclose that FinQA Pandas-to-SQL materialization changes recorded_at from T to space, and recommend datetime normalization. Pilot began before this observation hint; it is excluded from comparisons.
primary: Number of complete mixed size-four groups per exactly 64 CLI invocations, separately for each policy and allocator.
secondary: Contrasting pairs and diagnostic RLOO advantages
Calls, reported input/output/cache tokens, observed call seconds
Task/environment coverage and unfinished or unknown outcomes
budget_boundary: Do not start a call beyond the cap. If the final trajectory is unfinished it is saved with reward null and budget_cap truncation. A completed trajectory in an incomplete group retains its reward but the group is not counted in the primary yield.
failures: Invalid JSON consumes a call and returns format feedback. Unrequested host tool use is a policy failure with reward 0. A genuine transport failure consumes a call and has unknown reward, without automatic retry.
comparison_limits: Calls are exactly matched. Tokens, wall time and dollar cost are not. Two disjoint task blocks do not support a precise generalization estimate. Adaptive success rates describe a selected task mixture, not model improvement.

research.name: SARA
research.role: Implemented collection-only fixed-group adaptation of its Beta predictor and early abandonment; not a training replication.

research.name: VIGOR
research.role: Variance-based allocation motivation; no claim to reproduce its progressive training rounds.

research.name: PAIR
research.role: Selection changes the target distribution. Deterministic zero-probability abandonment cannot be corrected into an unbiased full-pool gradient by this demo.

research.name: SERA
research.role: Different MaxRL scale-equalization objective, not used for the mixed-group objective here.

research.name: Aperture
research.role: Requires a trained probe, outside the no-update constraint, so not executed.

recovery_reason: Original equal-budget v1 run encountered 792 transport failures in 960 calls. Preserve all raw evidence, treat it as an infrastructure-limited run, and run this separately labeled replication after a successful CLI health probe. Do not pool outcomes across protocols.
circuit_breaker: Any transport error stops new policy calls across the collection, after in-flight calls return. Preserve partial trajectories as unknown and do not automatically refill or silently retry.
adaptation_disclosure: A prespecified difficulty follow-up registered after observing the primary suite. Do not pool with the primary comparison or claim unseen-task replication.
